project: Techgram / Astra Edu — Student Intelligence Kernel
position: PHASE 5 COMPLETE [ADR-043, Journal Entry 45, commit 57bc1cb]: THE TECHGRAM WORLD ADAPTER + THE THIRTY-SCENARIO EXPERIMENT. The UCS boundary is real: src/adapter/ owns worlds (curriculum, prerequisites, prior weights, learning rules, 10 student archetypes); cognitive/ stays universal — concept names cross as opaque strings; priorWeights (targeting) vs externalWeights (THE EXTERNAL EVALUATOR) strictly enforced apart. Worlds: real UPSC Polity + real CBSE-8 (from the frozen seeds) + synthetic chain/flat/heavy/sparse. THE THIRTY: 30/30 scenarios PASS — 10 archetypes on Polity, 7 cross-world, 5 adversarial (30% noise, skipped days, interruptions every turn), 8 structural proofs. Executive vs matched linear: 30 wins / 0 ties / 0 losses, mean +3.13 true marks (heavy-tail +11 — the edge tracks the mechanism); belief error ~half of linear's everywhere. Structural laws held everywhere: replay byte-identical, frozen-organ shadow-belief identical, anti-Goodhart isolation (flip evaluator → score changes, decisions never), LLM OFF/ON identity, developmental divergence 13/13 testable, 1925/1925 utterances provenance-valid, S4 veto enforced in-run. The rig is a PERMANENT regression gate (test/phase5.test.ts). Defects caught by the experiment itself: the evaluator flip was a no-op on uniform weights (fixed w/ rank-decay); minimalContent needs the full ExamSpec or observe() goes NaN. Phases 0-5 all complete at kernel level. FULL REPORT (simple + technical): docs/PHASE5_EXPERIMENT_REPORT.md; raw data: docs/PHASE5_EXPERIMENT_RESULTS.json. NEXT per roadmap: Phase 6 (the demo) — GATED on the founder's direction. 271 tests (kernel 262 + web 9), typecheck clean. All evidence SIMULATED-world; efficacy UNKNOWN UNTIL PILOT.
